passages.label: A
passages.genre_substructure: Title/intro plus four separately named museum family programs: all-age; 0-5 with caregivers; 3-8; home activity. These are subject matter in G11 reading, not kindergarten product scope.

passages.label: B
passages.genre_substructure: Third-person everyday-service human-interest report with repeated visits, action, motives, customer quote and wider reaction.

passages.label: C
passages.genre_substructure: Explanatory essay on claimed cultural origins, language and geographical separation, ending with a normative view. Preserve explanation/cause/example/stance tasks, not the unsupported East/West/race generalizations.

passages.label: D
passages.genre_substructure: Applied-AI efficiency report: question, three human/mixed/automated decision groups, comparative finding and continuing human/training needs. Not three separately enumerated experiments.

author_requirements: A introduction and all four program profiles; use unambiguous target ages, access, booking and monthly attributes, no assumed exclusivity from one highlighted example.
B actions and quotes must support the claimed motives; no pity framing or claim of universal disability experience.
C use a bounded fictional explanatory setting or primary-verified factual material; do not reproduce racial/language-system myths. Mark the word queried in the actual paragraph.
D compare three contemporaneous decision conditions; describe method as a comparison, not list three experiments. Outcome must not establish all AI or real road safety.
source_quality_risks: A22 babies fit the specifically targeted 0-5 program, but all-age Family Friendly Days may also admit them. Do not treat suitable as exclusive eligibility.
A intro requests advance booking while one program is called drop-in: registration/walk-in logistics are not fully reconciled.
C history, pictographic/Latin classification and race/near-isolation causal simplifications not facts gold.
D33 three groups does not imply three experiments; grouping/allocation/control and actual underlying study not independently established.

passages.label: A
passages.genre_substructure: Graduation requirement notice: compulsory credit list, optional credits, online-credit note, literacy/date rule and community hours with adult/minor distinction. Text is fused in raw extraction.

passages.label: B
passages.genre_substructure: Third-person conservation-worker report with biography, activities, cooperation and population/time claims.

passages.label: C
passages.genre_substructure: Informational explanation starting from imagined sport situation, followed by physiology/neural examples, extension beyond sports and an application claim.

passages.label: D
passages.genre_substructure: Regenerative-biology research explanation: complex network, named signalling mechanism, sequence of cell responses and aspirational human application. Tone hopeful; exact species/conditions and evidence not verified.

author_requirements: Preserve a legible compulsory/optional list, distinct credit/hour units, nested online credits rather than adding them automatically, dates and age conditions; use explicit fictional school rules rather than unverified Ontario policy.
Conservation timeline and trend units must not imply one team caused population growth; do not copy current real-animal counts as verified.

Separate imagined and physical practice; specify whether a question asks physiological or emotional outcomes because both are stated in source. Do not turn possible overlap into equal performance or treatment advice.
Preserve a coherent multi-step mechanism and distinguish present observations from future application; hopeful author stance may coexist with untested human translation.
source_quality_risks: A fused tokens Icredit/1credit and civic sandcitizenship, omitted bullets and questionable literacy-rule date prevent treating raw word count or this notice as jurisdiction policy gold.
B species/population estimates and time-sensitive ranger statistics unverified.
C29 offers physical functions and emotional responses while the text explicitly mentions both: C/D are plausible overlapping answers. Do not imitate this as a uniquely keyed item.
C same neural circuits/physiological equivalence and performance claims overstate what these excerpts alone establish.

D whole-animal regeneration from any tiny limb, perfect restoration and human translation require species/central-disc, method, conditions and clinical evidence; not established by a confident expository tone.

passages.label: A
passages.genre_substructure: Interlibrary-loan service notice with borrower eligibility, timing, returns/recall, collection/access procedure and mandatory fee table: three library categories by two material types.

passages.label: B
passages.genre_substructure: First-person reflective parenting essay: other parents reaction, practical account, deeper motive, worries, daily practice and hopeful future. Not a service event report or nutrition instruction sheet.

passages.label: C
passages.genre_substructure: Explanatory research-based report about human attachment to dogs: question opening, domestication account, study illustration, important differences, proposed hormonal mechanism and personal closing quote.

author_requirements: One complete 3x2 fee table with labelled columns, all access and recall conditions; compare only options actually given, not an absent highest cell. No table-to-prose substitution.
First-person reflective narrative must contain both practical and deeper motives; keep equivalent paragraphs and mark contextual phrase. No diagnosis or claim that one caring routine cures distress.

Present similarities and differences, evidence function, metaphor and individual quotation without converting group averages into universal human/animal equivalence. Real biomedical facts need primary evidence or explicit fictional-study framing.
source_quality_risks: B57 asks capitalize on in paragraph2 but phrase occurs in the third paragraph in the cached body. Preserve source locator conflict; authored question must use actual paragraph position.
B worries/support context is not evidence that packed lunch prevents disorders or cures loneliness.
C opening says same response while later reports species differences; some dog cognition/appearance/neurochemical generalizations lack primary conditions.
C64 emotional-signal influence (C) is a broad possible mechanism and nurturing response (D) the more precise metaphor target; avoid overlapping broad/narrow distractors in new keys.

passages.label: A
passages.genre_substructure: Advice article with an opening situation and four numbered steps: shared interests, kindness, existing-friend introductions, initiating contact. Each has examples or contrasts.

passages.label: B
passages.genre_substructure: Private letter to a granddaughter: opening future frame, winter gift, father paying kindness forward, grandfather story, next generation and closing action-oriented moral. Retain salutation and sign-off.

passages.label: C
passages.genre_substructure: Migration-research report: bird seasonal context, multi-year tracking/sample methods, conditional climate model, observed tracks/distances and projected habitat changes.

passages.label: D
passages.genre_substructure: Survey-based report distinguishing day-level emotions and overall life satisfaction, different reports/age groups and two separate scales, followed by association interpretation.

author_requirements: Keep four explicit ordered step labels and their supporting examples; do not turn the text into a notice or treat a sensible unsupported recommendation as text evidence.
Provide entire letter across generations, including addressee/signature and a clear causal chain within the story; one helpful event alone does not replace the letter form.

Bind each number to captured birds, sampled birds, tracked birds and flights separately; one bird may contribute multiple flights. Future model predictions stay conditional on assumptions, not certainty.

Keep different constructs/cohorts/scales apart; do not pool 0-10 and 1-3 scores or infer phone-use causation from association. Paragraph-purpose options must distinguish function rather than provide/share near-synonyms.
source_quality_risks: A40 introduction and discussing surroundings both occur in the contact sequence; source wording may favour the final break-ice instruction without making the first action generally wrong.
C source has 50 sampled birds,56 caught,41 tracked and151 complete flights; do not silently equate units or assume every captured bird was tracked.
C48 future habitat model cannot make outcomes certain; the strongest fitting option concerns projecting tundra location.
D age labels for World Happiness Report, teen cohort claims and attributions/real statistics not independently verified.
D54 provide data(B)/share data(D) near-synonymous; original key not unique-best gold.
D smartphone association does not establish cause; scale10 and scale3 trends remain different datasets.
A_numbered_step_headings: Step 1 Look for people who have the same hobbies as you.
Step 2 Spend time around people who show kindness.
Step 3 Make new friends through your current friends.
Step 4 Introduce yourself to new people whenever possible.
